concept.name: Early stopping
concept.definition: Terminating iterative training when a monitored held-out metric stops improving, thereby limiting effective model complexity.
concept.intuition: It estimates how a fitted choice behaves on observations that were not used to fit that choice.
concept.mechanics: After each iteration, evaluate a validation metric, retain the best checkpoint, and stop after a preset patience without sufficient improvement.
concept.failure_modes: Random splitting, overlapping labels, repeated tuning, or an unprotected final test set can produce optimistic estimates.
concept.misconceptions: Validation measures conditional generalization under a split design; it does not guarantee future market performance.
concept.example: Validation loss bottoms at epoch 42 and fails to improve for 10 epochs, so training stops at 52 and restores epoch 42.
